nodes.speaker: Maud
nodes.text: I had a whole table of people in my head just now. All of them talking at once. I'd forgotten how loud it was. How good.

nodes.speaker: Maud
nodes.text: Here. Take these. A loaf is for carrying to someone who needs it. That's the only rule I've ever had.
[i]She is already kneading something. The smell of bread spreads out across the square like a held breath let go.[/i]
